blueprints.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces and AST Lint Sandboxing for Software Engineering
blueprints.abstract: Demonstrates that structured Agent-Computer Interfaces (ACI), AST pre-write lint checks, and 250-line file view limits achieve 12.5% pass@1 on SWE-bench by blocking syntax corruptions.

blueprints.title: AutoCodeRover: Autonomous Program Improvement via AST-Based Symbol Localization
blueprints.abstract: Combines AST symbol extraction with spectrum-based fault localization to slice and resolve GitHub issues with minimal token consumption.

blueprints.title: Open-Ended Self-Improving Autonomous Systems via Empirical Harness Evolution
blueprints.abstract: Introduces the Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) and ShinkaEvolve for treating agent harnesses as mutable software code tested against regression testbeds with atomic rollback.

blueprints.title: AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation via Monte Carlo Tree Search
blueprints.abstract: Explores agentic workflow topologies via MCTS, finding optimal verification gate placements and subagent role routing patterns that improve benchmark accuracy.

blueprints.title: Two-Level Recursive Agent Harness for Autonomous Software Engineering
blueprints.abstract: Presents Harness², a two-level recursive architecture separating intra-task behavioral contrast loops from inter-task meta-reflection with strict KEEP_BASE default gates and 28-skill cue-matched retrieval.
